findings: src/take-apart-client.js: the changes only touch rendering (a procedural PMREM studio environment, lights, tone mapping exposure, per-material tweaks). They add no network fetches, eval or Function calls, innerHTML, new dependencies or user-input handling.
The onBeforeCompile shader patch for 'Matte off white silicone' is a static string replacement of three.js shader chunks with constant values, so there is no injection surface.
The temporary studio scene's geometries and materials and the PMREM generator are disposed after the environment is generated, so no resource leak.

scripts/capture-take-apart.mjs: the new CAPTURE_DIR env var sets the output directory and does not normalize '..' segments, so a hostile value could write outside evidence/. This is low risk because it is operator-set dev tooling and not reachable from the served app. I suggest constraining it to evidence/.
src/patch-one-glb.js is a data-only module with no executable logic added. Vendored three.js, package manifests and page chrome are unchanged. No secrets or unsafe defaults were introduced.
The review file is written to runs/wo-gh-14/reviewer-security.output.md.
